  4. Formats and local processing

Choose the start and end

To remove the opening, increase the start time. To cut off the ending, reduce the end time. Choose 0 as the start to keep the opening. A cut from 1.25 to 3.00 requests a clip about 1.75 seconds long. Use decimals to position the cut more precisely.

This tool exports one continuous segment. If you need to remove a section in the middle and join the remaining parts, use an editor that supports multiple segments. For changing the visible area of each frame, use the video cropper.

Check the MP4 before sharing

  1. Wait for the download link and check the measured duration. Video frame and audio packet timing can make it differ slightly from the requested interval.
  2. Play the first and last moments of the exported clip. Listen to confirm it includes the intended sound.
  3. Download and open the saved MP4 in the app where you plan to use it. If you only need one still image, extract that frame as PNG.

Formats and local processing

Use a file with one video track and at most one audio track. A supported MP4, MOV or WebM can be written as MP4, depending on the browser’s available decoders and AVC and AAC support. If a track cannot be kept, the tool stops before offering a download.

The tool writes a new file using Mediabunny’s trim and conversion API. It re-encodes video, so output size and quality can differ from the source. The source file stays on your device and remains available unchanged.
